issue_title: [Feature] Add file backup before save operation

implementation.summary: Added backup functionality to TodoStorage.save() that creates a .bak file before overwriting existing files. The feature is enabled by default and can be disabled via the backup=False constructor parameter.
implementation.approach: Minimal implementation following TDD: Added backup parameter to __init__, created _create_backup() helper method that uses shutil.copy2, integrated backup call in save() before atomic rename.

risks_and_limitations: Backup uses shutil.copy2 which preserves metadata but may fail on special file systems
Backup is created before temp file write, so a crash between backup and temp write leaves backup intact
No cleanup mechanism for old backups - only one backup is retained
